ko.title: 80% 고갈: 이란 전쟁이 남긴 미사일 요격기 부족 사태의 내막

segments.src: ## A Stockpile Under Strain
segments.tr: ## 압박받는 비축량

segments.src: Nearly seven months of sustained conflict involving Iran have done more than dominate headlines — they have quietly drained one of the U.S.
segments.tr: 이란과 관련된 거의 7개월간의 지속적인 분쟁은 단순히 헤드라인을 장식하는 것 이상의 결과를 낳았습니다. 이는 미

segments.src: military's most critical missile-defense assets.
segments.tr: 군에서 가장 중요한 미사일 방어 자산 중 하나를 조용히 고갈시켰습니다.

segments.src: According to people familiar with Pentagon inventory assessments, the campaign has consumed roughly 80% of the available stockpile of a key interceptor used to shoot down incoming ballistic and cruise missiles.
segments.tr: 펜타곤의 재고 평가에 정통한 관계자들에 따르면, 이번 작전으로 인해 날아오는 탄도 미사일과 순항 미사일을 격추하는 데 사용되는 핵심 요격기 가용 비축량의 약 80%가 소진되었습니다.

segments.src: That figure, while difficult to verify independently given the classified nature of munitions accounting, has circulated among defense analysts and congressional staff briefed on readiness levels.
segments.tr: 이 수치는 군수품 회계의 기밀성 때문에 독립적으로 검증하기는 어렵지만, 대비 태세에 대해 보고받은 국방 분석가들과 의회 직원들 사이에서 유포되었습니다.

segments.src: If accurate, it represents one of the steepest wartime drawdowns of an advanced interceptor system in decades — and a warning sign for a defense-industrial base that was not built for this pace of consumption.
segments.tr: 만약 이 수치가 정확하다면, 이는 수십 년 만에 가장 가파른 첨단 요격 시스템의 전시 소모 사례 중 하나이며, 이러한 소모 속도를 감당하도록 설계되지 않은 방위 산업 기반에 대한 경고 신호입니다.

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions
segments.tr: ## 요격기가 다른 군수품과 다른 이유

segments.src: Unlike artillery shells or small-diameter bombs, advanced interceptors are among the most complex weapons the United States produces.
segments.tr: 포탄이나 소구경 폭탄과 달리, 첨단 요격기는 미국이 생산하는 가장 복잡한 무기 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Each unit integrates seeker technology, propulsion, guidance software, and often a kill vehicle designed to physically strike an incoming warhead — components sourced from a narrow supply chain of specialized manufacturers.
segments.tr: 각 유닛은 탐색기 기술, 추진체, 유도 소프트웨어, 그리고 종종 날아오는 탄두를 물리적으로 타격하도록 설계된 킬 비히클(kill vehicle)을 통합하고 있으며, 이러한 구성 요소들은 소수의 전문 제조업체 공급망에서 조달됩니다.

segments.src: That complexity is precisely why replenishment is so slow.
segments.tr: 바로 그 복잡성 때문에 보충이 매우 느린 것입니다.

segments.src: Analysts who track defense production note that even under surged manufacturing conditions, annual output of top-tier interceptors has historically been measured in the hundreds, not thousands.
segments.tr: 국방 생산을 추적하는 분석가들은 생산량을 급격히 늘리는 상황에서도 최고 수준의 요격기 연간 생산량은 역사적으로 수천 대가 아닌 수백 대 단위로 측정되어 왔다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Rebuilding a stockpile that has been drawn down by 80% could plausibly take **several years**, not months, absent a dramatic expansion of production capacity.
segments.tr: 80%까지 줄어든 비축량을 재건하는 데는 생산 능력을 획기적으로 확장하지 않는 한, 수개월이 아닌 **수년**이 걸릴 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## A Bottleneck Decades in the Making
segments.tr: ## 수십 년간 이어진 병목 현상

segments.src: Industry observers point to a familiar set of constraints:
segments.tr: 업계 관측통들은 익숙한 일련의 제약 요인들을 지적합니다:

segments.src: - **Limited production lines.** Prime contractors run specialized facilities that cannot simply "scale up" on short notice without new tooling, certified suppliers, and trained technicians.
segments.tr: - **제한된 생산 라인.** 주 계약업체들은 새로운 툴링, 인증된 공급업체, 숙련된 기술자 없이는 단기간에 단순히 "규모를 확대"할 수 없는 전문 시설을 운영합니다.

segments.src: - **Long subcomponent lead times.** Sensors, solid-rocket motors, and specialty electronics often come from a small number of qualified vendors, some of whom are themselves capacity-constrained.
segments.tr: - **긴 하위 부품 리드 타임.** 센서, 고체 로켓 모터, 특수 전자 장치는 종종 소수의 자격을 갖춘 공급업체로부터 공급받는데, 이들 중 일부는 자체적으로 생산 능력에 한계가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Competing global demand.** The same interceptor families are also fielded by U.S. allies, meaning any surge in domestic production must be weighed against existing foreign military sales commitments.
segments.tr: - **경합하는 글로벌 수요.** 동일한 요격기 제품군이 미 동맹국들에도 배치되어 있으므로, 국내 생산의 급증은 기존의 대외 군사 판매 약속과 비교하여 신중하게 결정되어야 합니다.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have periodically pushed for multi-year procurement contracts intended to give manufacturers the demand certainty needed to invest in expanded capacity.
segments.tr: 의회 예산 편성자들은 제조업체들이 생산 능력 확장에 투자하는 데 필요한 수요 확실성을 제공하기 위해 주기적으로 다년 조달 계약을 추진해 왔습니다.

segments.src: But those investments take time to materialize, and a shortage that emerges during an active conflict cannot be solved on the same timeline it was created.
segments.tr: 그러나 그러한 투자가 실현되기까지는 시간이 걸리며, 활발한 분쟁 중에 발생하는 부족 사태는 그것이 발생한 것과 동일한 일정 내에 해결될 수 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Strategic Consequences
segments.tr: ## 전략적 결과

segments.src: Perhaps more significant than the industrial story is what a depleted interceptor stockpile means for decision-making in Washington.
segments.tr: 산업적인 이야기보다 더 중요한 것은 요격기 비축량 고갈이 워싱턴의 의사결정에 의미하는 바일 것입니다.

segments.src: Military planners generally maintain reserve thresholds precisely so that a real-world contingency doesn't leave the country under-defended against a follow-on threat, whether from Iran or another actor entirely.
segments.tr: 군사 기획자들은 일반적으로 실제 상황이 발생했을 때 이란이나 다른 행위자로부터의 후속 위협에 대해 국가가 방어 능력을 상실하지 않도록 예비 임계치를 유지합니다.

segments.src: Defense officials and outside experts who study escalation dynamics suggest that a stockpile running this thin could make policymakers more cautious about further military engagement, more selective about which threats warrant an interceptor response, and more reliant on allied systems or alternative defensive layers in the interim.
segments.tr: 확전 역학을 연구하는 국방 관계자들과 외부 전문가들은 비축량이 이렇게 얇아지면 정책 입안자들이 추가적인 군사 개입에 더 신중해지고, 어떤 위협에 요격기로 대응할지 더 선별적으로 결정하며, 당분간은 동맹국의 시스템이나 대체 방어 계층에 더 의존하게 될 수 있다고 제안합니다.

segments.src: It could also affect how quickly the U.S.
segments.tr: 또한 이는 미국이 얼마나 신속하게

segments.src: can support partners who rely on American-made interceptors for their own air defense.
segments.tr: 자체 방공을 위해 미국산 요격기에 의존하는 파트너들을 지원할 수 있는지에도 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계

segments.src: The Pentagon has not publicly confirmed the specific 80% figure, and defense officials have historically been reluctant to disclose precise interceptor inventories for operational security reasons.
segments.tr: 펜타곤은 80%라는 구체적인 수치를 공개적으로 확인하지 않았으며, 국방 관계자들은 역사적으로 작전 보안상의 이유로 정확한 요격기 재고를 공개하는 것을 꺼려왔습니다.

segments.src: Still, the broader pattern — high-tempo missile defense operations outpacing a constrained industrial base — echoes concerns that lawmakers and defense analysts have raised for years about the U.S.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고, 고강도 미사일 방어 작전이 제약된 산업 기반을 앞지르는 더 넓은 패턴은 입법자들과 국방 분석가들이 수년간 제기해 온 미

segments.src: munitions supply chain.
segments.tr: 군수품 공급망에 대한 우려를 반영합니다.

segments.src: In the coming budget cycle, expect renewed debate in Congress over emergency procurement funding, incentives for expanding production capacity, and whether allied nations should be brought more directly into co-production arrangements to spread manufacturing risk.
segments.tr: 다가오는 예산 주기에는 긴급 조달 자금, 생산 능력 확장을 위한 인센티브, 그리고 제조 위험을 분산하기 위해 동맹국들을 공동 생산 협정에 더 직접적으로 참여시켜야 하는지에 대한 의회의 새로운 논쟁이 예상됩니다.

segments.src: For now, the shortage stands as a reminder that even the world's most advanced military can be constrained not by strategy or willpower, but by how fast a factory floor can turn out precision hardware.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 이번 부족 사태가 세계에서 가장 앞선 군대조차도 전략이나 의지가 아닌, 공장 현장에서 정밀 하드웨어를 얼마나 빨리 생산해낼 수 있는지에 의해 제약받을 수 있다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions
segments.tr: ## इंटरसेप्टर अन्य गोला-बारूद से अलग क्यों हैं

segments.src: Unlike artillery shells or small-diameter bombs, advanced interceptors are among the most complex weapons the United States produces.
segments.tr: तोपखाने के गोलों या छोटे व्यास वाले बमों के विपरीत, उन्नत इंटरसेप्टर सबसे जटिल हथियारों में से हैं जो संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका बनाता है।

segments.src: Each unit integrates seeker technology, propulsion, guidance software, and often a kill vehicle designed to physically strike an incoming warhead — components sourced from a narrow supply chain of specialized manufacturers.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक इकाई में सीकर तकनीक, प्रणोदन, मार्गदर्शन सॉफ्टवेयर, और अक्सर आने वाले वारहेड पर भौतिक रूप से हमला करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया एक किल वाहन एकीकृत होता है — ऐसे घटक जो विशेष निर्माताओं की एक संकीर्ण आपूर्ति श्रृंखला से प्राप्त होते हैं।

segments.src: That complexity is precisely why replenishment is so slow.
segments.tr: यही जटिलता ठीक वही कारण है कि पुनर्पूर्ति इतनी धीमी है।

segments.src: Analysts who track defense production note that even under surged manufacturing conditions, annual output of top-tier interceptors has historically been measured in the hundreds, not thousands.
segments.tr: रक्षा उत्पादन पर नज़र रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि उत्पादन स्थितियों में वृद्धि के बावजूद, शीर्ष-स्तरीय इंटरसेप्टर का वार्षिक उत्पादन ऐतिहासिक रूप से सैकड़ों में मापा गया है, हजारों में नहीं।

segments.src: Rebuilding a stockpile that has been drawn down by 80% could plausibly take **several years**, not months, absent a dramatic expansion of production capacity.
segments.tr: 80% तक कम हो चुके भंडार का पुनर्निर्माण, उत्पादन क्षमता के नाटकीय विस्तार के बिना, महीनों नहीं बल्कि **कई वर्षों** ले सकता है।

segments.src: ## A Bottleneck Decades in the Making
segments.tr: ## दशकों से बन रही एक बाधा

segments.src: Industry observers point to a familiar set of constraints:
segments.tr: उद्योग पर्यवेक्षक बाधाओं के एक परिचित समूह की ओर इशारा करते हैं:

segments.src: - **Limited production lines.** Prime contractors run specialized facilities that cannot simply "scale up" on short notice without new tooling, certified suppliers, and trained technicians.
segments.tr: - **सीमित उत्पादन लाइनें।** मुख्य ठेकेदार विशेष सुविधाओं को संचालित करते हैं जो नए टूलींग, प्रमाणित आपूर्तिकर्ताओं और प्रशिक्षित तकनीशियनों के बिना अल्प सूचना पर केवल "बढ़ाया" नहीं जा सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Long subcomponent lead times.** Sensors, solid-rocket motors, and specialty electronics often come from a small number of qualified vendors, some of whom are themselves capacity-constrained.
segments.tr: - **लंबा उप-घटक लीड समय।** सेंसर, ठोस-रॉकेट मोटर, और विशेषता इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स अक्सर योग्य विक्रेताओं की एक छोटी संख्या से आते हैं, जिनमें से कुछ स्वयं क्षमता-सीमित हैं।

segments.src: - **Competing global demand.** The same interceptor families are also fielded by U.S. allies, meaning any surge in domestic production must be weighed against existing foreign military sales commitments.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिस्पर्धी वैश्विक मांग।** वही इंटरसेप्टर परिवार अमेरिका के सहयोगियों द्वारा भी तैनात किए जाते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि घरेलू उत्पादन में किसी भी वृद्धि को मौजूदा विदेशी सैन्य बिक्री प्रतिबद्धताओं के खिलाफ तौला जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have periodically pushed for multi-year procurement contracts intended to give manufacturers the demand certainty needed to invest in expanded capacity.
segments.tr: संसदीय विनियोजकों ने समय-समय पर बहु-वर्षीय खरीद अनुबंधों के लिए दबाव डाला है जिसका उद्देश्य निर्माताओं को विस्तारित क्षमता में निवेश करने के लिए आवश्यक मांग निश्चितता प्रदान करना है।

segments.src: But those investments take time to materialize, and a shortage that emerges during an active conflict cannot be solved on the same timeline it was created.
segments.tr: लेकिन उन निवेशों को साकार होने में समय लगता है, और एक सक्रिय संघर्ष के दौरान उत्पन्न होने वाली कमी को उसी समय सीमा पर हल नहीं किया जा सकता जिस समय सीमा में यह बनाई गई थी।

segments.src: ## Strategic Consequences
segments.tr: ## रणनीतिक परिणाम

segments.tr: शायद औद्योगिक कहानी से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण यह है कि एक खाली हो चुका इंटरसेप्टर भंडार वाशिंगटन में निर्णय लेने के लिए क्या मायने रखता है।

segments.src: Military planners generally maintain reserve thresholds precisely so that a real-world contingency doesn't leave the country under-defended against a follow-on threat, whether from Iran or another actor entirely.
segments.tr: सैन्य योजनाकार आम तौर पर आरक्षित सीमाओं को ठीक इसलिए बनाए रखते हैं ताकि एक वास्तविक दुनिया की आकस्मिकता देश को किसी अनुवर्ती खतरे के खिलाफ कम-सुरक्षित न छोड़े, चाहे वह ईरान से हो या किसी अन्य अभिनेता से।

segments.src: Defense officials and outside experts who study escalation dynamics suggest that a stockpile running this thin could make policymakers more cautious about further military engagement, more selective about which threats warrant an interceptor response, and more reliant on allied systems or alternative defensive layers in the interim.

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions
segments.tr: ## لماذا تختلف الصواريخ الاعتراضية عن الذخائر الأخرى

segments.src: Unlike artillery shells or small-diameter bombs, advanced interceptors are among the most complex weapons the United States produces.
segments.tr: على عكس قذائف المدفعية أو القنابل صغيرة القطر، تُعد الصواريخ الاعتراضية المتطورة من بين أكثر الأسلحة تعقيداً التي تنتجها الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: Each unit integrates seeker technology, propulsion, guidance software, and often a kill vehicle designed to physically strike an incoming warhead — components sourced from a narrow supply chain of specialized manufacturers.
segments.tr: تدمج كل وحدة تكنولوجيا الباحث، والدفع، وبرمجيات التوجيه، وغالباً ما تحتوي على مركبة قتل مصممة لضرب الرأس الحربي القادم مادياً - وهي مكونات يتم الحصول عليها من سلسلة توريد ضيقة من الشركات المصنعة المتخصصة.

segments.src: That complexity is precisely why replenishment is so slow.
segments.tr: هذا التعقيد هو السبب الدقيق وراء بطء عملية التجديد.

segments.src: Analysts who track defense production note that even under surged manufacturing conditions, annual output of top-tier interceptors has historically been measured in the hundreds, not thousands.
segments.tr: يشير المحللون الذين يتابعون الإنتاج الدفاعي إلى أنه حتى في ظل ظروف التصنيع المكثفة، كان الإنتاج السنوي للصواريخ الاعتراضية من الطراز الأول يُقاس تاريخياً بالمئات، وليس بالآلاف.

segments.src: Rebuilding a stockpile that has been drawn down by 80% could plausibly take **several years**, not months, absent a dramatic expansion of production capacity.

segments.src: ## A Bottleneck Decades in the Making
segments.tr: ## عنق زجاجة استغرق بناؤه عقوداً

segments.src: Industry observers point to a familiar set of constraints:
segments.tr: يشير مراقبو الصناعة إلى مجموعة مألوفة من القيود:

segments.src: - **Limited production lines.** Prime contractors run specialized facilities that cannot simply "scale up" on short notice without new tooling, certified suppliers, and trained technicians.
segments.tr: - **خطوط إنتاج محدودة.** يدير المقاولون الرئيسيون منشآت متخصصة لا يمكنها ببساطة "التوسع" في وقت قصير دون أدوات جديدة، وموردين معتمدين، وفنيين مدربين.

segments.src: - **Long subcomponent lead times.** Sensors, solid-rocket motors, and specialty electronics often come from a small number of qualified vendors, some of whom are themselves capacity-constrained.
segments.tr: - **فترات زمنية طويلة للمكونات الفرعية.** غالباً ما تأتي المستشعرات، ومحركات الصواريخ الصلبة، والإلكترونيات المتخصصة من عدد صغير من البائعين المؤهلين، وبعضهم يعاني هو نفسه من قيود في القدرة الإنتاجية.

segments.src: - **Competing global demand.** The same interceptor families are also fielded by U.S. allies, meaning any surge in domestic production must be weighed against existing foreign military sales commitments.
segments.tr: - **الطلب العالمي المتنافس.** يتم استخدام نفس عائلات الصواريخ الاعتراضية أيضاً من قبل حلفاء الولايات المتحدة، مما يعني أن أي زيادة في الإنتاج المحلي يجب أن توازن مقابل التزامات المبيعات العسكرية الأجنبية القائمة.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have periodically pushed for multi-year procurement contracts intended to give manufacturers the demand certainty needed to invest in expanded capacity.
segments.tr: دفع المخصصون في الكونغرس بشكل دوري نحو عقود شراء متعددة السنوات تهدف إلى منح الشركات المصنعة اليقين بشأن الطلب اللازم للاستثمار في توسيع القدرات.

segments.src: But those investments take time to materialize, and a shortage that emerges during an active conflict cannot be solved on the same timeline it was created.
segments.tr: لكن هذه الاستثمارات تستغرق وقتاً لتؤتي ثمارها، ولا يمكن حل النقص الذي يظهر أثناء صراع نشط بنفس الجدول الزمني الذي نشأ فيه.

segments.src: ## Strategic Consequences
segments.tr: ## العواقب الاستراتيجية

segments.src: Perhaps more significant than the industrial story is what a depleted interceptor stockpile means for decision-making in Washington.
segments.tr: ربما يكون ما يعنيه استنفاد مخزون الصواريخ الاعتراضية بالنسبة لصنع القرار في واشنطن أكثر أهمية من القصة الصناعية.

segments.src: Military planners generally maintain reserve thresholds precisely so that a real-world contingency doesn't leave the country under-defended against a follow-on threat, whether from Iran or another actor entirely.

segments.src: Defense officials and outside experts who study escalation dynamics suggest that a stockpile running this thin could make policymakers more cautious about further military engagement, more selective about which threats warrant an interceptor response, and more reliant on allied systems or alternative defensive layers in the interim.

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions
segments.tr: ## Por que os interceptadores são diferentes de outras munições

segments.src: Unlike artillery shells or small-diameter bombs, advanced interceptors are among the most complex weapons the United States produces.
segments.tr: Ao contrário de projéteis de artilharia ou bombas de pequeno diâmetro, os interceptadores avançados estão entre as armas mais complexas que os Estados Unidos produzem.

segments.src: Each unit integrates seeker technology, propulsion, guidance software, and often a kill vehicle designed to physically strike an incoming warhead — components sourced from a narrow supply chain of specialized manufacturers.

segments.src: That complexity is precisely why replenishment is so slow.

segments.src: ## A Bottleneck Decades in the Making

segments.src: Industry observers point to a familiar set of constraints:
segments.tr: Observadores da indústria apontam para um conjunto familiar de restrições:

segments.src: - **Long subcomponent lead times.** Sensors, solid-rocket motors, and specialty electronics often come from a small number of qualified vendors, some of whom are themselves capacity-constrained.

segments.src: ## Why Interceptors Are Different From Other Munitions

segments.src: Unlike artillery shells or small-diameter bombs, advanced interceptors are among the most complex weapons the United States produces.

segments.src: Each unit integrates seeker technology, propulsion, guidance software, and often a kill vehicle designed to physically strike an incoming warhead — components sourced from a narrow supply chain of specialized manufacturers.

segments.src: That complexity is precisely why replenishment is so slow.

segments.src: ## A Bottleneck Decades in the Making

segments.src: Industry observers point to a familiar set of constraints:
segments.tr: Branchenbeobachter weisen auf eine Reihe bekannter Einschränkungen hin:

segments.src: - **Limited production lines.** Prime contractors run specialized facilities that cannot simply "scale up" on short notice without new tooling, certified suppliers, and trained technicians.
segments.tr: - **Begrenzte Produktionslinien.** Hauptauftragnehmer betreiben spezialisierte Anlagen, die ohne neue Werkzeuge, zertifizierte Lieferanten und geschulte Techniker nicht einfach kurzfristig „hochskaliert“ werden können.

segments.src: - **Long subcomponent lead times.** Sensors, solid-rocket motors, and specialty electronics often come from a small number of qualified vendors, some of whom are themselves capacity-constrained.
segments.tr: - **Lange Vorlaufzeiten für Subkomponenten.** Sensoren, Feststoffraketenmotoren und Spezialelektronik stammen oft von einer kleinen Anzahl qualifizierter Anbieter, von denen einige selbst kapazitätsmäßig eingeschränkt sind.

segments.src: - **Competing global demand.** The same interceptor families are also fielded by U.S. allies, meaning any surge in domestic production must be weighed against existing foreign military sales commitments.
segments.tr: - **Konkurrierende globale Nachfrage.** Dieselben Abfangraketen-Familien werden auch von US-Verbündeten eingesetzt, was bedeutet, dass jede Steigerung der inländischen Produktion gegen bestehende Verpflichtungen aus ausländischen Militärverkäufen abgewogen werden muss.

segments.src: Congressional appropriators have periodically pushed for multi-year procurement contracts intended to give manufacturers the demand certainty needed to invest in expanded capacity.
segments.tr: Die Haushaltsplaner des Kongresses haben sich periodisch für mehrjährige Beschaffungsverträge eingesetzt, um den Herstellern die Nachfragesicherheit zu geben, die für Investitionen in erweiterte Kapazitäten erforderlich ist.

segments.src: For now, the shortage stands as a reminder that even the world's most advanced military can be constrained not by strategy or willpower, but by how fast a factory floor can turn out precision hardware.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, sự thiếu hụt là một lời nhắc nhở rằng ngay cả quân đội tiên tiến nhất thế giới cũng có thể bị giới hạn không phải bởi chiến lược hay ý chí, mà bởi tốc độ mà một sàn nhà xưởng có thể sản xuất ra phần cứng chính xác.
